recipe.title: Cardamom & Caramelized Banana Baked Oats
recipe.description: An elevated breakfast creation featuring warm aromatic cardamom, rich mashed banana oats, toasted pecans, and a caramelized banana topping.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly butter two 8-ounce ceramic ramekins or a small 2-person baking dish.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the rolled oats, baking powder, ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, and sea salt.
In a separate bowl, thoroughly mash 1 banana. Whisk in the egg, milk, melted butter, and 1 tablespoon of maple syrup until smooth.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry oat mixture and stir until combined. Gently fold in the dark chocolate chips and half of the chopped pecans.
Divide the oat mixture evenly between the prepared ramekins. Slice the second banana into diagonal rounds and arrange them decoratively on top, pressing lightly into the batter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 28-30 minutes until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from oven, sprinkle with remaining pecans, and drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of maple syrup over the hot baked oats before serving.

tips: Use bananas with heavy brown spots for maximum natural sweetness and deep aromatic flavor.
For a restaurant-style finish, sprinkle a pinch of raw turbinado sugar over the sliced bananas before baking to create a crunchy, caramelized crust.
